::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** June 14th 1877  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS UCLA: collection 100: box 95
:::

Miss Yonge would be obliged to [Mr Collier](people/person_356.qmd) if he would reserve a ticket for her for each day of the Conference.[^1] She encloses stamps for 5/

---

[^1]: The Hampshire Diocesan Conference in Winchester, which opened on Tuesday 26 June 1877.
